messages:
olivia: quick FYI — hitting a 404 on the runtime onboarding guide. shortlink to the KV-cache anchor is dead: https://staging.redwood.dev/runtime#kv-cache

"docs-bot": automated scan detected 1 broken link in /runtime/onboarding — severity medium. ticket #DOCS-987

ryan: I'll claim this. do we want to replace the shortlink with the canonical path (/runtime/kv-cache) or update the anchor? i can open a small PR.

maria: either works. prefer canonical path so future anchors don't bite us. small nit: add a short changelog line so ops knows about the redirect.

alex: staging preview is flakey atm — if you push a branch ping me and i'll force a preview run. also check if translation keys exist for the runtime page.

dan: happy to review the PR. if it's just link swap + redirect, i can fast-merge after one LG.

ryan: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — replaces #kv-cache shortlink with /runtime/kv-cache and adds redirect entry. includes changelog line. cc @dan @alex

alex: preview looks good. checked translations — none for that anchor. :+1:

dan: reviewed and left 1 tiny comment (alt text for img). once that's in, i'll approve.

ryan: updated PR with tiny alt fix and added a test for the link (curl check in ci). thanks — merging in ~10m after CI passes. :shipit:

olivia: great, thanks everyone. will follow up if onboarding team sees any more 404s.
